note: The provider registry the console, the worker and the CLI all read. Written by hand and asserted against the implementations in scripts/fetch-models.mjs by npm run check:model-budget, so the two cannot drift. Poly Haven, NASA and the Khronos sample assets need no token at all: that is what keeps a fresh clone able to fetch a redistributable model. The others are switches that are simply off without a key.

providers.label: Poly Haven
providers.note: 521 models, CC0 for the whole library, published as .gltf plus textures and packed to .glb at 1k.

providers.label: NASA 3D Resources
providers.note: 227 folders in the nasa/NASA-3D-Resources repository; public domain, recorded as CC0 because the obligations are the same.

providers.label: Khronos glTF Sample Assets
providers.note: 162 samples; the licence is read from each model's own LICENSE.md, and anything that is not CC0 or CC BY is refused.

providers.label: Sketchfab
providers.note: The catalogue's own models came from here. 'Free download' is not 'open licence': the licence label decides.

providers.label: Smithsonian Open Access
providers.note: Open Access 3D, CC0, needs an api.data.gov key.

providers.label: Poly Pizza
providers.note: The archived remains of Google Poly.

providers.label: Direct URL
providers.note: An admin pinned this URL in data/model-sources.json. The declared licence is checked like any other, and the download still goes through the budget.
